request_text: What governing body must consent before altering production during the blackout period?

evidence_documents.content: The Change Advisory Board must approve any production modification during the year-end change freeze.
The blackout calendar lists maintenance dates and office closure periods.
The production inventory records service names, regions, and owning teams.
The governance roster lists committee members and quarterly meeting rooms.

request_text: How long may former-customer records remain before they must be erased?

evidence_documents.content: Closed customer account records must be deleted within thirty days after the contractual retention period ends.
The customer directory contains account managers and renewal months.
The storage report forecasts archive capacity for the next fiscal year.
Former employees return laptops and badges on their final day.

request_text: What liability coverage must a supplier carry before we can place an order?

evidence_documents.content: Before purchase authorization, every supplier must provide proof of two million dollars in commercial general liability insurance.
The insurance directory lists broker telephone numbers and office addresses.
The ordering guide explains purchase order filename conventions.
The vendor catalog lists available products and standard delivery windows.

request_text: When should affected clients hear from us after a service disruption begins?

evidence_documents.content: Notify impacted customers within thirty minutes after a customer-facing outage is declared.
The client roster lists account names and assigned success managers.
The service calendar lists planned maintenance and training dates.
The writing guide defines approved fonts for customer presentations.

request_text: Which screening must a contractor finish before receiving company credentials?

evidence_documents.content: Contractors must pass the background investigation before identity credentials or system accounts are issued.
The credential inventory lists badge printers and spare access cards.
Orientation includes welcome remarks, lunch, and a building tour.
The screening calendar lists annual health-fair appointments.

request_text: Which executive approved the exception allowing customer data outside the required country?

evidence_documents.content: Customer data must remain in the contracted country unless a documented exception is granted.
The region inventory lists data centers and available storage tiers.
The executive directory lists leadership biographies and assistants.
The exception template contains blank fields for justification and signatures.

request_text: Where will the payments service recover, and how quickly must it return after a regional loss?

evidence_documents.content: Payments fail over to the western secondary region with a recovery time objective of sixty minutes.
The region map shows office locations and employee seating capacity.
The payments roadmap lists planned features for the next two quarters.
Recovery training sessions occur on the first Tuesday of each month.

request_text: Who must sign off when a purchase exceeds fifty thousand dollars?

evidence_documents.content: Purchases above fifty thousand dollars require written authorization from the Vice President of Finance.
The purchase catalog lists standard equipment bundles and prices.
The finance directory lists department extensions and office locations.
The signature guide shows approved email footer formatting.

request_text: What inclusive-design checks must be completed before customers receive the new interface?

evidence_documents.content: Before public launch, the interface must pass keyboard navigation, screen-reader, and color-contrast testing.
The customer launch calendar lists announcement dates and presentation rooms.
The design directory lists team members and software licenses.
The interface inventory lists page names and component owners.

request_text: How soon must a departing worker lose credentials and application entry?

evidence_documents.content: Disable all user accounts and revoke access tokens within four hours of confirmed employment termination.
The departure calendar lists farewell events and final interview times.
The application catalog lists system names and business owners.
The credential style guide describes badge colors for each office.

request_text: The supplier records disagree about deletion timing. Identify both requirements.

evidence_documents.content: The executed data processing agreement requires customer records to be erased within thirty days after termination.
The security addendum requires customer records to be retained for ninety days after termination.
The supplier directory lists account contacts and renewal dates.
The deletion runbook describes how to format archive job names.

request_text: What was the final outcome of the penetration test for this release?

evidence_documents.content: The penetration test is scheduled for the week before the release window.
The security finding template contains empty severity and remediation fields.
The release inventory lists services and deployment regions.
The testing roster lists assigned engineers and their time zones.
